---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new check for booklens
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What accessibility gap or workflow pain are you hitting? Describe the book or
pipeline that booklens does not currently handle. Note the relevant EPUB
Accessibility or WCAG requirement where you can.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like booklens to do. If you are proposing a new rule, sketch the
check and the failure it should report. If you are proposing a new fix, note
whether it is safe to apply automatically.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
